results.corrected_title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol
results.corrected_summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra (flagship) and GPT-6.2 Sol (cheaper model) on 2026-11-17. By OpenAI's own evaluations, Astra beats Claude Fable 5.2 by 5.5 points on Agents' Last Exam at about 5% of the cost. Astra pricing fell to $8/$40 per million input/output tokens (from $10/$50), and Sol costs $2/$10. OpenAI says Astra is its first externally released model to reach the High threshold for AI self-improvement in its Preparedness Framework.
key_facts: Released 2026-11-17 in ChatGPT Work and Codex and in the API
Astra price cut: $10 to $8 input and $50 to $40 output per million tokens
Sol is $2 input and $10 output per million tokens
Vendor claim: Astra beats Claude Fable 5.2 by 5.5 points on Agents' Last Exam at about 5% of the cost
First externally released OpenAI model to meet the High threshold for self-improvement under the Preparedness Framework
results.issues: Single secondary source; benchmark claims are OpenAI's own.
